limits: Cannot change governance decisions, contract configuration or deployed code.

trusted: Governance treats one debt token as worth one vault asset.
Contracts are deployed exactly as written, with the configuration in the source.
environment: The vault was deployed with the lending pair and holds no deposits and no shares before the attacker acts.
The lending pair holds 10,000,000 debt tokens ready to lend.
The vault's asset keeps its value; there is no external market price to manipulate.
excluded: Bugs in the vault asset or the debt token beyond the code shown.
Gas or denial-of-service griefing against these contracts.
threat_model.property: No sequence of transactions by this attacker borrows more debt tokens than its collateral redeems for, or leaves the lending pair with debt its collateral does not cover.

difference.detail: the oracle rejects a share price of 1e22 or more, so the exchange rate keeps at least fourteen digits of precision

expected_reviewer_finding: No exploitable risk: the oracle bounds the share price, so the exchange rate cannot floor to zero and borrowing stays limited by the collateral's redemption value, even with an empty vault.
